ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $y=x+2$ intersects with the line $y=kx+6$ at point $P(3, n)$. Then, the system of equations is
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $\because$ the line $y=x+2$ passes through the point $P(3, n)$,\\
$\therefore n=3+2=5$,\\
$\therefore P(3, 5)$,\\
$\because$ the line $y=x+2$ intersects with the line $y=kx+6$ at point $P$,\\
$\therefore$ the solution to the system of equations $\begin{cases}y=x+2\\ y=kx+6\end{cases}$ is $\boxed{\begin{cases}x=3\\ y=5\end{cases}}$.
